title: Title
description: A landed title: an empire, kingdom, duchy, county, or barony.

id.description: Tier prefix followed by a lowercase name. Must equal the file name.

tier.description: Must agree with the id prefix: e, k, d, c, b in that order.

de_jure_liege.description: The title one tier above this one. Null only for the top of a hierarchy.

capital.description: For a county, the barony that is its capital. For higher tiers, the title one tier below that holds the seat of power.

holder.description: The character holding this title at the scenario start date. Null means the title is uncreated or unheld.

succession_law.description: Required for duchy tier and above. Counties and baronies inherit their liege's law in version 0.

sources.description: Public sources for the historical claims in this record. At least one is required for any record naming a real place or person.
